## Summary
- New pure-stdlib project `research/wagering-modular-experts`: weighted-score wagering mechanisms (Lambert et al. 2008) as a budget-balanced, replayable mixture-of-experts gate under recurring regime drift.
- Findings: plain WSWM locks in (worse than equal weights); a fixed-share wealth tax repairs it and beats Hedge+FS, but subsidises lazy free-riders (incentive cost quantified).
- 13 unit tests (budget balance, sybil-proofness, truthfulness, etc.); README with limitations. Portfolio page and root README updated.
